# Kharch Log — llms-full.txt

Generated: 2026-09-08
Source: https://kharchlog.in/
Index: https://kharchlog.in/llms.txt

Kharch Log is an Android expense tracker by Easy Peeze Tools. It captures bank/UPI SMS, lets you confirm drafts, and stores expenses in your own Google Sheet. Lifetime unlock INR 149. Your data stays in your Google account - not on our servers as the source of truth.

## Facts

- Product: Kharch Log (Android)
- Publisher: Easy Peeze Tools (easypeeze.com)
- Price: INR 149 one-time lifetime
- Data: Google Sheets + Drive file scope; SMS on-device draft -> your sheet
- Support: easypeezetools@gmail.com
- Sister product: Pdf Buddy (Windows PDF editor) at https://easypeeze.com/

## Features

### Manual Voice Entry
URL: https://kharchlog.in/features/manual-voice-entry/
Add expenses by typing or voice when SMS is missing.

### Sms Auto Capture
URL: https://kharchlog.in/features/sms-auto-capture/
Read bank/UPI debit SMS and draft expenses automatically.

### Review Inbox
URL: https://kharchlog.in/features/review-inbox/
Confirm or edit SMS drafts before they hit your sheet.

### Google Sheets Sync
URL: https://kharchlog.in/features/google-sheets-sync/
Store every expense in your own Google Sheet (file-scoped).

### Reports Insights
URL: https://kharchlog.in/features/reports-insights/
Month/week/year spend, categories, and carry-forward balance.

### Share Invoice
URL: https://kharchlog.in/features/share-invoice/
Share a Pay-to image/PDF/text summary of spending.
